purpose: Reusable validated Bloomberg ASKB-to-API recipes. Entries should capture programmatic routes discovered through ASKB and validated through Bloomberg API, Bloomberg Excel, BQuant, or the local broker.

entry_schema.original_question: The user or ASKB discovery question
entry_schema.bloomberg_concept: Bloomberg dataset, function, screen, or concept
entry_schema.api_route: BQL, BLPAPI, BDP, BDH, BDS, Excel, BQuant, or no_api_route
entry_schema.bloomberg_service: For BLPAPI routes, for example //blp/refdata, //blp/bqlsvc, //blp/apiflds, //blp/instruments, or //blp/exrsvc
entry_schema.query_type: ReferenceDataRequest, HistoricalDataRequest, BDS, sendQuery, ExcelGetGridRequest, etc.
entry_schema.security_or_universe: Exact security, index, country, curve, screen, or universe syntax
entry_schema.fields: Exact Bloomberg field mnemonics or BQL data items
entry_schema.excel_formula: BDP, BDH, BDS, or BQL Excel formula if applicable
entry_schema.date_handling: Date format, range, as-of semantics, release lag, or point-in-time handling
entry_schema.coverage_limits: History, geography, asset-class, or coverage limitations
entry_schema.point_in_time_limits: Restatement, survivorship, as-known, or PIT limitations
entry_schema.minimal_test: Smallest reproducible API or formula test
entry_schema.validation_status: unvalidated, validated, failed, no_api_route, or superseded
entry_schema.validation_command: Command or manual validation route used
entry_schema.validation_result_shape: Rows, columns, and expected field names
entry_schema.askb_session_note: Path to the summarized ASKB session note

entries.original_question: How can I retrieve the last price and company name for Apple Inc. equity using Bloomberg APIs?
entries.excel_formula: BDP("AAPL US Equity", "PX_LAST") and BDP("AAPL US Equity", "NAME")
entries.date_handling: Point-in-time reference request; no date range required.
entries.currency_source_adjustments: Default Bloomberg source and currency handling.
entries.entitlements: Requires Bloomberg Desktop API entitlement and active Bloomberg Terminal session.
entries.coverage_limits: Single listed equity reference data smoke test.
entries.point_in_time_limits: Returns current/reference values, not historical point-in-time snapshots.
entries.minimal_test: Create a BLPAPI Session to localhost:8194, open //blp/refdata, send ReferenceDataRequest for AAPL US Equity with fields PX_LAST and NAME.
entries.validation_result_shape: One security with fieldData containing PX_LAST=291.130000 and NAME=APPLE INC.
entries.failure_modes: Broker ports 8000 and 8001 were not listening; direct BLPAPI validation succeeded.
